claire-launch: Quiet corridor for apac-slice starts in 15m. This thread = canonical checklist. Keep replies terse.

omar-sre: infra checks I need: spare nodes >=2, GPU headroom >=10%, alerts for restart-loop and OOM.

kev-dev: noted. No new pins or model uploads during corridor. If we revert pin use admin API (kev will run).

lucy-qe: smoke suite queued at T+5m and T+15m. I'll post counts here.

claire-launch: rollout plan: ramp 0->12% over 12m, hold 8m, continue if p95 steady. Abort if user errors >0.7% for 4m or smoke regressions >8 in 15m.

omar-sre: infra abort: pod restarts >4 in 6m OR GPU mem pressure >88% -> I flip traffic to fallback and notify.

kev-dev: rollback snippet in runbook for pins:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"\
  https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/pins/revert\
  -d '{"slice":"apac-slice","to":"stable-2026-02"}'
```

deploy-bot: Enabling quiet corridor policy 'quiet-apac-5167899999' -> new pins blocked, noncritical deploys blocked. Current enforcement: active.

lucy-qe: T+5m smoke: 0 regressions / 150 tests. latency p95=250ms.

claire-launch: all right. Owners: kev for model revert, omar for infra rollback, lucy for smoke verification, claire coordinating. If rollback happens post short cause+action+owner in #release-war-room.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramping: current 3.2% -> target 12% over 12m. Metrics feed -> https://dash.internal/quiet/5167899999

omar-sre: alerts created: `quiet/apac-restarts` (6m), `quiet/apac-gpu` (3m).

kev-dev: ready with admin creds if revert needed.

lucy-qe: T+15m smoke: 1 minor NER mismatch (allowed). continuing.

claire-launch: final: any objections? 10s.

lucy-qe: :thumbsup:

omar-sre: :thumbsup: infra green.

kev-dev: good to go.

claire-launch: launching ramp in 2m. Keep updates short here; move incidents to #release-war-room. Good luck.
